notes.subject: car
notes.text: Grey car with a visible roof rack and side mirrors on all car coverage. Laos has a similar car; the Dominican one has thick black stripes on the bars.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Short plates that look blue-tinged, or slightly green on the left side, once blurred.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Poles are very often painted pink, green, or a mix of the two.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Solid white edge lines with a single yellow centre line, noticeably thinner than in Mexico.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Tropical, with rainforest covering much of the country.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Pastel-painted stone houses with rusty sheet-metal roofs; exposed white brick walls are fairly common.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is thin overall, especially in the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The middle of the country is mountainous, while the north and south are flatter.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Completely flat farmland, more built up than the flat areas in the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Fairly flat but with some hills and gentle rolling, unlike the totally flat south.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Oil palm plantations are mostly in the southwest and just north of the central mountains.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Fully green utility poles are mostly in the southeast, with a few on the far east side near the northeast border.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The top right car bar faces forward almost everywhere, but backward in the southeast.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A blue rope is often visible on the bottom right bar of the car in the backward-bar areas.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The largest lake in the highlands, ringed by mountains and some volcanoes.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Small white bollards with two black stripes on road 1 northeast of Quetzaltenango.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Phone numbers starting with 2 exist only in the capital.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: White rectangular stickers reading 'electricista' appear only in the capital.
